posts.text: “Good morning! It’s Sunday! I had to go potty very very early (or very late, I get confused). I schnozzelated thumb guy awake and he got up and let me in the backyard. But then he couldn’t go back to sleep. Why is that so hard for humans? I can go to sleep very quickly. Anyway, Zoë  saw that he was awake and demanded that they go out very early. But I needed my beauty sleep so they went without me. But when they got back I was very excited to go out but Zoë didn’t want to just walk around the ne
Good night. Very glad everyone is safe.
RT @TrumpDailyPosts: 🚨🚨SHOTS FIRED UPDATE: ACCORDING TO FOX NEWS JOHN ROBERTS, TRUMP DOES NOT WANT THE DINNER CANCELLED AND THEY ARE TRYING…

If someone really got a gun past the metal detectors, that’s a really big deal. There are very few spaces in DC that the secret service has protected for more years and more thoroughly than this ballroom. But I’m not buying anything we hear for now.
“I am calling for a complete and total shutdown of the White House Correspondents Association Dinner until we know what the hell is going on!”
I'm gonna need a lot of scrutiny of the betting markets.
Will no one think of the Sunday show bookers?

The race to be wrong first has begun.

Nothing wrong with waiting until the morning to form an opinion, never mind assert facts.

Weird thing to tweet after the chaos.


Fox News (@FoxNews)

🪩 The vibe? Iconic. @EmilyCompagno
